findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dynamic import vulnerabilities
 * @description Dynamic imports of untrusted modules can lead to code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/dynamic-import
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("importlib").getMember(["import_module", "reload"]).getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("__import__").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("wrapt").getMember("importer").getACall()
select call, "Dynamic import or code execution operation that could load untrusted code."
findings.hypothesis: Dynamic import vulnerabilities in wrapt.importer module

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Detailed analysis of dynamic imports in wrapt
 * @description Examine specific dynamic import calls found in wrapt package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity medium
 * @id py/wrapt-dynamic-imports-detailed
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-470
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Look for various dynamic import patterns
  call = API::builtin("__import__").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("importlib").getMember("import_module").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("importlib").getMember("__import__").getACall() or
  exists(string moduleName |
    moduleName = ["exec", "eval", "compile"] and
    call = API::builtin(moduleName).getACall()
  )
select call, "Dynamic import or code execution: " + call.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Dynamic imports in wrapt could potentially load untrusted code if user input reaches them
